name: Netway Internet
summary: West Perth ISP (Netway Technologies Pty Ltd, ACN 076 696 243, reg. 6 Dec 1996): formed from the Jan 1997 merger with Rockingham's Coastlink Communications, trading as Netway Coastlink / Coastlink Internet Services / Netway Internet (nw.com.au); launched the PowerDSL ADSL brand Nov 2001 (Perth metro, then Rockingham/Mandurah); acquired by Up'N'Away.

events.details: Merged with Coastlink Communications (Rockingham/Kwinana, ex Col's Point BBS), trading as 'Netway Coastlink'.
Launched PowerDSL ADSL brand ('HomePower'/'BizPower') to Perth metro users, expanding to Rockingham and Mandurah by Mar 2002; business name POWERDSL registered 24 Aug 2001 (cancelled 4 Oct 2010).

events.details: Acquired by Up'N'Away (before Up'N'Away itself was acquired by iiNet, Jan 2008); PowerDSL address ranges (202.7.144.0/20, 202.71.160.0/20) subsequently announced under AS4739 Internode/iiNet. GST registration cancelled 30 Jun 2006, suggesting wind-down from mid-2006.
